'15' WHEN '충북' THEN '16' ELSE '99' END AS AREA_CD , g.SUPER_ID AS SUPER_ID , a.ATM_CO_CD AS ATM_CO_CD , m.ATM_TYPE_CD AS ATM_TYPE_CD , a.MODEL_CD AS MODEL_CD , c.MANAGE_TYPE_CD AS MANAGE_TYPE_CD , THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_03 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_12 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '22' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_22 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '32' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_32 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '61' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_61 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '71' AND DEVICE_ID = '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_71_O , SUM(CASE AS FAULT_02 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_15 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAULT_25 , SUM(CASE WHEN ERR_GROUP_CD = '73' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
